name: pawsoff-privacy-suite
description: Local-first Chrome MV3 privacy extension. This package.json exists only for dev scripts; the extension itself is zero-dependency and has no build step.

scripts.pack: rm -f getpawsoff.zip && zip -r -X -q getpawsoff.zip manifest.json src icons LICENSE THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md -x src/content/vendor/autoconsent-rules.json src/learn/README.md
